annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 2006/28/EC amending Council Directives 72/245/EEC and 70/156/EEC (radio interference and type-approval of vehicles; 24 GHz short-range radar)
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive 2006/28/EC amending Council Directives 72/245/EEC and 70/156/EEC (radio interference and type-approval of vehicles; 24 GHz short-range radar)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 65/27
annotation.summary_en: 2006 Commission Directive adapting EU vehicle type-approval and radio-interference directives to technical progress. It simplifies Certificate of Conformity reporting for vehicles with 24 GHz short-range radar, drops 79 GHz reporting requirements and removes an attestation stamp. Not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Annexes of Directive 72/245/EEC on vehicle radio interference
Requires only 24 GHz short-range radar indication in Certificate of Conformity
Removes administration stamp from Annex III C attestation
Member States must transpose by 30 June 2006 and apply from 1 July 2006
